title: 第11章 血狼帮

content_zh:
萧腾双目无神的看着萧叶，对方的表现，将他的自信全部粉碎，在他心中留下了不可磨灭的阴影。
炼体丹、蛇蛟血，都被他服用了，可他居然还是被萧叶远远抛在身后。他甚至觉得，自己这辈子都没有可能超越萧叶了。
“如果以后再来惹我，别怪我无情。”萧叶冷冷扫了萧腾一眼，迈步走出废墟。
说到底，他还是个十五岁少年，还没到动不动就杀人的地步，更何况萧腾和他是一个村子的。
“萧贤侄！”这时，脸上挂着和蔼笑容的石战走了过来，但他脸上的笑容，萧叶怎么看都有种阴谋盎然的味道。
特别是石战的称呼，萧贤侄？
石战年逾古稀，萧叶今天年关才满十五岁，当对方的孙子都够了，现在却被称呼为萧贤侄？这也太扯淡了吧。
“石战爷爷。”萧叶脸上露出笑容，对石战行礼，怎么说对方也是长辈，他还是得尊重的。
“萧贤侄啊。”石战热情的拉过萧叶，脸上的笑容越加和蔼，他指向身后道，“来来来，看看石爷爷的孙女长得如何？”
萧叶一愣，顺着石战的视线看去，这时候他才发现，萧战身后还跟着一位少女。
那少女略显青涩，身穿鹅黄色的衣裙，身姿欣长，相貌清纯可人，与吴媚儿的妩媚就是两个极端。
萧叶不得不承认，这少女是个不错的美人胚子，如果再过个几年，肯定可以压过吴媚儿，成为青阳镇第一美女。
“不错。”萧叶机械般点了点头，不知道石战葫芦里卖什么药。
“呵呵……”石战闻言笑容更甚，凑了过来，手中不知道何时拿出一张亲帖，“既然萧贤侄你也满意，那就收下我孙女的亲帖吧。”
“亲帖！”萧叶脑门垂下无数黑线，让他收下一个还没有发育完全少女的亲帖？
“石战爷爷，你不是拿我寻开心吧？您孙女还不满十四岁吧？”萧叶苦笑道。
“我孙女虽然才十三岁，但是那胸挺的，那屁股翘的……啧啧！”石战凑近，露出一副男人都懂的笑容，“只要你收下亲帖，我做主，立刻让她和你入洞房都行！”
在青阳镇，虽然少女只要年满十四岁，就可以参加选婚，但是要正真的成亲，至少还要等到十六岁。
石战拼命推销自己孙女的模样，让萧叶当场石化，这还是德高望重的石家村村长吗？萧叶有种爆粗口的冲动。
“爷爷！信不信我把你胡子拔光！”石青青又羞又怒，使劲在石战腰间拧了一把，疼得石战直抽冷气。

同时，石青青还偷偷看向萧叶，清纯可人的脸上浮现一丝羞红。
她跟随着石家村的村民，来观看这次的选婚比武，却意外看见萧叶惊艳表现，芳心一阵悸动。
在真灵大陆，强者在任何地方，都会受人他人的崇拜和尊敬。
她石青青当然也希望自己未来的男人，可以像萧叶这般出色。所以当她听到石战的建议后，居然鬼使神差的同意了。
“石老不死的，你真无耻啊！”吴狮须发皆张的走了过来，老脸气得通红，他指着石战就骂开了。
“哼，吴老头，你还有脸说我？你敢说你和我不是同一个目的？”石战冷哼道，扫了一眼跟来的吴媚儿。
吴狮一阵尴尬，随后他换上一副和蔼的表情，对萧叶道：“萧贤侄啊，你觉得我孙女吴媚儿怎么样？”
听着两人一模一样的台词，萧叶脚下一个趔趄，这老家伙，不会也是推销自己孙女的吧？
只是对象……却是吴媚儿！
萧叶脸上浮现一丝冷意，看到自己比萧腾出色，就又转头来找自己吗？
可惜，他萧叶可不答应啊。
吴媚儿望着的萧叶，秋水般的眸子中，闪现果决之色。
青阳镇百年难见的天才就在自己面前，绝对值得她放下一切，再次去主动出击。
“萧叶哥哥，以前是我不对，媚儿向你道歉，希望你能收下媚儿的亲帖。”吴媚儿掏出一张亲帖，递了过去。
当着全镇人的面，萧叶嘴角浮现一丝嘲讽，他只是冷冷的看着吴媚儿，任由对方举着亲帖。
吴媚儿玉手轻微的颤抖着，她身为青阳镇第一美女，亲自递交亲帖，对方却连接都不接，这就像抽了她一巴掌，让她脸颊火辣辣的疼。
望着这一幕，众多少年一阵哀嚎，青阳镇第一美女亲自递交亲帖，萧叶居然接都不接？

content_en:
Xiao Teng looked at Xiao Ye with dull eyes. The other party's performance shattered all his confidence and left an indelible shadow in his heart.
He had taken body refining pills and snake dragon blood, but he was still left far behind by Xiao Ye. He even felt that it would be impossible for him to surpass Xiao Ye in this life.
"If you mess with me again in the future, don't blame me for being heartless." Xiao Ye glanced at Xiao Teng coldly and walked out of the ruins.
After all, he was still a fifteen-year-old boy, not yet ready to kill people, not to mention that Xiao Teng and he were from the same village.
"Nephew Xiao Xian!" At this time, Shi Zhan came over with a kind smile on his face, but the smile on his face seemed to Xiao Ye to be full of conspiracy.
Especially Shi Zhan’s title, Xiao Xian’s nephew?
Shi Zhan is over seventy years old, and Xiao Ye has only turned fifteen today. It's enough to be considered the other's grandson, but now he is called Xiao Xian's nephew? This is too nonsense.
"Grandpa Shi Zhan." Xiao Ye smiled and saluted Shi Zhan. After all, he was also an elder, so he still had to respect him.
"Nephew Xiao Xian." Shi Zhan pulled Xiao Ye enthusiastically, and the smile on his face became more kind. He pointed behind him and said, "Come, come, let's see how Grandpa Shi's granddaughter looks like?"
Xiao Ye was stunned and followed Shi Zhan's line of sight. Only then did he realize that there was a girl following Xiao Zhan.
The girl was slightly young, wearing a goose-yellow dress, with a tall figure and a pure and pleasant appearance. She was the opposite extreme of Wu Meier's charm.
Xiao Ye had to admit that this girl was a good beauty. If she gave it a few years, she would definitely surpass Wu Mei'er and become the most beautiful girl in Qingyang Town.
"Not bad." Xiao Ye nodded mechanically, wondering what kind of medicine was sold in Shi Zhan's gourd.
"Haha..." Shi Zhan smiled even more when he heard this. He came over and took out a wedding card from his hand. "Since you are satisfied with it, nephew Xiao Xian, then accept my granddaughter's wedding card."
"Proposal!" Countless black lines hung from Xiao Ye's forehead, asking him to accept a proposal from a girl who was not yet fully developed?
"Grandpa Shi Zhan, are you making fun of me? Your granddaughter is not yet fourteen years old, right?" Xiao Ye said with a bitter smile.
"Although my granddaughter is only thirteen years old, her breasts are perky and her ass is perky... tsk tsk!" Shi Zhan came closer and showed a smile that all men understand, "As long as you accept the wedding invitation, I will make the decision and let her enter the bridal chamber with you immediately!"
In Qingyang Town, although girls can participate in marriage selection as long as they are fourteen years old, they have to wait until they are at least sixteen to actually get married.
Shi Zhan tried his best to promote his granddaughter, which made Xiao Ye petrified on the spot. Is this still the respected head of Shijia Village? Xiao Ye had the urge to swear.
"Grandpa! Believe it or not, I will pull out all your beard!" Shi Qingqing was ashamed and angry. She pinched Shi Zhan's waist hard, causing Shi Zhan to gasp in pain.
At the same time, Shi Qingqing secretly looked at Xiao Ye, with a hint of blush on her pure and pleasant face.
She followed the villagers of Shijia Village to watch the marriage selection competition, but unexpectedly saw Xiao Ye's amazing performance, and her heart throbbed.
In the True Spirit Continent, strong people will be worshiped and respected by others wherever they are.
She, Shi Qingqing, of course hopes that her future man can be as outstanding as Xiao Ye. So when she heard Shi Zhan's suggestion, she unexpectedly agreed.
"Shi Lao Immortal, you are so shameless!" Wu Shi walked over with his hair and beard spread out, his face turned red with anger, he pointed at Shi Zhan and scolded him.
"Hmph, Old Man Wu, do you still have the nerve to criticize me? Do you dare to say that you and I don't have the same purpose?" Shi Zhan snorted coldly and glanced at Wu Mei'er who was following.
Wu Shi was embarrassed for a while, then he put on a kind expression and said to Xiao Ye: "Nephew Xiao Xian, what do you think of my granddaughter Wu Mei'er?"
Listening to the two people's exact lines, Xiao Ye staggered. This old guy,Isn't he also promoting his granddaughter?
It's just that the target... is Wu Mei'er!
A cold look appeared on Xiao Ye's face. Seeing that he was better than Xiao Teng, did he turn to look for him again?
It's a pity that Xiao Ye doesn't agree.
Wu Mei'er looked at Xiao Ye, with determination flashing in her autumn-like eyes.
A rare genius in Qingyang Town was right in front of her, and it was definitely worth putting down everything and taking the initiative again.
"Brother Xiao Ye, it was my fault in the past. Meier apologizes to you. I hope you can accept Meier's wedding invitation." Wu Meier took out a wedding invitation and handed it over.
In front of the whole town, a trace of ridicule appeared on the corner of Xiao Ye's mouth. He just looked at Wu Mei'er coldly and allowed the other party to hold up the wedding invitation.
Wu Meier's beautiful hands were trembling slightly. As the most beautiful woman in Qingyang Town, she personally submitted the wedding invitation, but the other party didn't answer it. It was like a slap in the face, making her cheeks burn with pain.
Looking at this scene, many young people wailed. The most beautiful woman in Qingyang Town personally submitted the wedding invitation, but Xiao Ye didn't even accept it?
